answer_key.why: The merged bean-003 as the line built it (tic-tac-toe-py PR #4). Its pre-merge review checked choose_move against an independent oracle on all 2,097 positions where O is to move: 0 mismatches, sides taken lowest first. The tests do leave the side tie-break unpinned, which a strict auditor may note as a test gap; it is not a defect in the code.
